name: Redwood Lakeside
shortDescription: A lakeside villa enclave by Redwood Luxury near Bang Tao, with 3 and 4 bedroom villas on plots of 400 to 902 sqm.
description: A lakeside villa enclave by Redwood Luxury near Bang Tao, with 3 and 4 bedroom villas on plots of 400 to 902 sqm. Four villa types (Palm, Orchid, Lotus, Lily) include single-storey and two-storey designs, each with a private pool. Heavy landscaping and a shuttle to local beach and shopping hubs are part of the offer.
facilities: Free shuttle to Bang Tao Beach, Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket
researchNotes: Papaya page is internally inconsistent: 34 vs 27 villas; built-up 175-272 in listing vs 326 to 500+ in text; floors 2 listed but Type B single-storey. Also marketed as 'One Residence Lakeside by Redwood Luxury' on some portals. Official site not found.
